CLI Module Documentation

This module provides a command-line interface (CLI) to perform emotion prediction using a fine-tuned BERT-based model.

Run the CLI with the predict command and either –text or –file.

Functions

src.cli.cli.main(ctx)[source]

📘 Emotion Prediction CLI Tool Run –help for usage instructions.

src.cli.cli.predict(text=<typer.models.OptionInfo object>, file=<typer.models.OptionInfo object>, verbose=<typer.models.OptionInfo object>)[source]

This command analyzes the input text or file to predict the emotion.

You must provide either the –text/-t option with a string to analyze, or the –file/-f option with a path to a text file.

Optionally, use –verbose/-v to display extra debug information during prediction.

Parameters:

  • text (str) – Input text to analyze. Mutually exclusive with ‘file’.

  • file (Path) – Path to a text file containing input text. Mutually exclusive with ‘text’.

  • verbose (bool) – If True, displays extra debug information.

Raises:

typer.Exit – If neither –text nor –file is provided.

Example:

cli.py predict –text “I am so happy today!” cli.py predict –file ./input.txt –verbose

How to Use

python cli.py predict --text "I am so happy today!"
python cli.py predict --file path/to/file.txt
python cli.py predict --file input.txt --verbose

CLI Options

--text, -t TEXT

A single input sentence for emotion prediction.

--file, -f FILE

A path to a .txt file containing input sentences (one per line).

--verbose, -v

If set, enables debug logging and prints additional output.

Model Components

These components are imported from src.inference.cli_inference.

load_emotion_model

src.inference.cli_inference.load_emotion_model(model_path, tokenizer_path)[source]

Load a pre-trained BERT-based emotion classification model and tokenizer.

Parameters:

  • model_path (str) – Path to the directory containing the saved model files.

  • tokenizer_path (str) – Path to the directory containing the saved tokenizer files.

Returns:

A tuple containing: - model (BertForSequenceClassification): The loaded emotion classification model. - tokenizer (BertTokenizer): The tokenizer used to preprocess input text. - device (torch.device): The device (CPU or GPU) the model is loaded on.

predict_emotion_single

src.inference.cli_inference.predict_emotion_single(text, model, tokenizer, device, class_names)[source]

Predict emotion for a single text input.

Parameters:

  • text (str) – Input text string.

  • model – Loaded emotion classification model.

  • tokenizer – Corresponding tokenizer.

  • device – Device where model runs.

  • class_names (list) – List of emotion class names.

Returns:

Predicted emotion label.

Return type:

str
